fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry transport in FWLM service, carrying troops across water and open terrain at speeds that outpace any ground vehicle. Their vulnerability to ambush in confined terrain is offset by the tactical flexibility they offer on League worlds with extensive coastlines or open plains. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of burning gel, these platoons carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry. The short range and danger of carrying volatile fuel make flamer duty one of the most hazardous assignments in the platoon.
